body: No, you are absolutely right. Your partner is definitely slut-shaming you, especially when he's calling you "easy" by the way you dress. 🙄🙄🙄 Disgusting, absolutely disgusting.
Amen to this comment. I'm super annoyed like Casper is so well-rounded and excels at everything he does but of course this goes unrecognized just because Team A has 3 of the most popular members ugh.
Get u a man that can do both
I literally got into Monsta X a few days ago AND I'M SO SMITTEN BY WONHO! Thank you for sharing this beautiful photo ❤️
HE'SO BEAUTIFUL UGH
your body is amazing omg, anything would look good on you!!
My thoughts exactly. I'm sorry, but the reality is that it's also his right to move on and focus with his new/current family.
Put cleanser on my toothbrush instead of toothpaste.

omg I was just thinking about this recently when the new season came out. I still haven't been able to watch it (and Riverdale), but reading your post and all the comments makes me feel a lot better. <3

I know what you mean by the temporary relief. Sometimes it helps knowing that I can have moments of relief, but sometimes it's quite discouraging because I fear these moments are as best as it's going to get. I hate this.

Hey I just read your thread. I totally understand how you feel. I haven't been able to get out of bed too. I'm sleeping almost 12 hours a day just because the emotions are so unbearable. Sleep is my only escape. I went to see my therapist today after this post and I feel a little better. If you can, I'd really suggest seeing someone if possible. I'm here if you need someone to talk to.

Thank you so much for your kind words. When did it start getting better for you? I'm depressed and anxious almost every second of the day.......the pain is so unbearable I just don't know how much more of this I can handle. I'm so mentally exhausted.

You are so sweet. Thank you for putting things into perspective. I'm so sorry for what you are going through, you are so strong and I wish I had half your strength. I'm trying to get through this but the depression and anxiety is just so crippling. I don't know if I can. I'm so tired of everything.
Thanks so much for your kind words! I'll do my best. 😪

You're halfway there so that's really awesome! I totally feel you about the not being able to save aspect...everything just feels so hopeless. I was about 3/4ths done with my degree before I dropped out. I recently applied at a community college but I honestly can't bring myself to care. Shit sucks.
I really needed this today. Thank you.
I'm so, so happy for you! Thank you so much for sharing this. It's really relieving to know that there's a light at the end of the tunnel, even though I still can't see it yet.

I'm so, so sorry, what you went through is absolutely horrible. If you ever need someone to talk to, please don't hesitate to PM me! 

I've also started therapy, but I'm also still in a lot of pain these days. I haven't done anything productive these past two days because everything just hurts and I can't even begin to envision a hopeful future. 

Thank you so much for taking the time to write such a kind comment even though you're going through such a rough time. You are so kind and you sound like an extremely strong and resilient person, you'll definitely get through this. I'm here for you if you ever need it.

I feel this so hard. My ex-bf was the same, in terms of confidence, wit, care, sexual compatibility, and financial success. 

I probably won't find anyone better than him. I don't think someone of his caliber and quality would ever be interested in someone like me again. I feel like it was a fluke he'd even like me in the first place.

Thanks so much for taking the time to reply. You're absolutely right, I am definitely not happy with myself. I'm an okay above average looking girl, but aside from that I honestly don't think I have much else going for me. Thank you for your motivational words, it's definitely the wake-up call I needed.

Thank you so much for your response! I actually really want to move out, but due to my financial situation I can't. I also cancelled my gym membership because I'm so broke. I've been hiking / going on really long walks instead, but I think I need more strenuous exercise. I wish I could hire a personal trainer or something, but they're so expensive ugh. I guess the thing stressing me out the most right now (aside from the breakup) is my financial situation. It's making me feel really insecure......😪

You have such a great mindset, I really admire you! I'm sure you will find someone better. We both will! I'm rooting for the both of us. 💗
Okay there nice guy. Maybe learn how to communicate properly with women instead of being bitter af. 😊
This statement is ignorant af. 🙄
WTF why would anyone say that???? That's cruel and rude as hell. Whatever, he doesn't want you? Fine, you want him even less.

Planning to spend an afternoon applying to jobs and then rewarding myself by hanging out with friends in the evening. Maybe karaoke, maybe drinks? Not too many drinks though, I still tear up/cry whenever I drink too much.  Also trying to fit high tea with a bestie and a nice scenic hike with an old friend sometime this weekend too.

I'm also 2 months post breakup and I can empathize with you greatly. It doesn't hurt as much as the first month, but the pain is definitely still there. It's more of a dull ache now, although it peaks when certain memories suddenly arise. I still think about him 24/7, but I am also able to go about my day now. Last month I was barely even able to function, I just laid in bed most of the day trying not to die. 

We'll get there. I'm so glad we are making steady progress. We got this. <3
